benchmark_outcome_row.primary_outcome_source: Methods: The primary end point was locally assessed PFS.
benchmark_outcome_row.anchor_as_printed: Median progression-free survival was significantly improved with ribociclib plus fulvestrant versus placebo plus fulvestrant: 20.5 months (95% CI, 18.5 to 23.5 months) versus 12.8 months (95% CI, 10.9 to 16.3 months), respectively (hazard ratio, 0.593; 95% CI, 0.480 to 0.732; P < .001)
benchmark_outcome_row.notes: JCO 2018 primary report, downloaded by Zaid by hand; no supplement files on the publisher page

effect_of_interest: assignment; intended all-randomized comparison, not a claim that every participant has complete outcome data
analysis_population: 726 randomized postmenopausal women, 484 versus 242; full analysis set; 210 versus 151 PFS events
definition: Time from randomization to first documented progression or death from any cause, local investigator/radiology RECIST 1.1 assessment; event-free censored at last adequate tumor assessment
time_window: Primary PFS analysis, data cutoff 3 November 2017; median time randomization to cutoff 20.4 months; not a fixed 20.4-month outcome
report_version: JCO primary report, online 3 June 2018, 36:2465–2472, DOI10.1200/JCO.2018.78.9909; 10-page Code PDF including end matter
